_comment: buddy-scheduler history store schema. Managed exclusively by the tool.

matrix._description: Symmetric match-count matrix. Keys are member names (strings). Values are objects mapping partner names to non-negative integer counts. matrix[A][B] must equal matrix[B][A]. Missing entries implicitly equal 0.

sit_out_counts._description: Per-member sit-out count. Keys are member names. Values are non-negative integers. Missing entries implicitly equal 0.

_validation_rules: matrix must be symmetric: matrix[A][B] == matrix[B][A] for all stored pairs
all count values must be non-negative integers
sit_out_counts values must be non-negative integers
entries for members absent from the current team roster are silently ignored during pairing
entries are pruned only when --prune-history is requested with --update-history
_write_contract: written atomically: temp file in same directory -> fsync -> os.replace
previous version backed up to <path>.backup before rename
concurrent write access serialised with fcntl.lockf(LOCK_EX)
